test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which government initiative primarily focuses on improving human development by ensuring healthcare and nutrition for women and children?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poshan Abhiyaan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan**, also known as the **National Nutrition Mission**, was launched by the Government of India on **8 March 2018**, coinciding with International Women's Day.
 
• The initiative aims to address the issue of **malnutrition** among women, children, and adolescents by ensuring proper nutrition and healthcare facilities.
 
• It primarily focuses on reducing **stunting, undernutrition, anemia** (among young children and women), and low birth weight in babies, targeting children aged **0-6 years** and pregnant women.
 
• The program utilizes technology-driven solutions, such as **mobile apps and real-time monitoring systems**, to track progress and ensure effective delivery of services.
 
• Under Poshan Abhiyaan, initiatives like **Poshan Pakhwada** and **Rashtriya Poshan Maah** are implemented annually to create awareness about nutrition and promote community participation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Features of Poshan Abhiyaan:**

 
 
• The mission adopts a **multi-ministerial approach** involving ministries like Women and Child Development, Health, and Education.
 
• It is implemented in collaboration with **state governments** to ensure coverage across all districts in India.
 
• The program promotes **behavioral change** among communities through awareness campaigns, workshops, and training programs.
 
• Funds under Poshan Abhiyaan are shared between the **Central Government and State Governments** in a **60:40 ratio** (90:10 for North-Eastern states and Himalayan states).
 
• The initiative incorporates the use of **Anganwadi Workers** and **ASHA workers** to directly engage with beneficiaries, ensuring last-mile delivery.
 
 
 
• **Relevant Data:**
 
 
• India has the highest number of **malnourished children** globally, with reports showing that **35.5%** of children under the age of 5 years are stunted, as per the **National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5)** conducted in **2019-2021**.
 
• The mission targets to reduce **stunting** to **25%** by **2022**, from the baseline of **38.4%** recorded in the **NFHS-4**.
 
• It aims to reduce **anemia** among women and children by **3% annually** and ensure 100% coverage of pregnant women with supplementary nutrition.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Schemes:**
 
 
• **Digital India:** Focuses on digital empowerment of citizens and is unrelated to healthcare or nutrition.
 
• **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao:** Aims to improve the **sex ratio** and promote **education for girls** but does not address healthcare and nutrition directly.
 
• **Skill India Mission:** Focuses on **enhancing vocational skills** for employment and is not related to nutrition or healthcare.
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan:** Specifically targets nutrition and healthcare improvements for women and children, making it the most relevant initiative for the question.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• The initiative aligns with the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDG)**, particularly **SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)** and **SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being)**.
 
• India's efforts under Poshan Abhiyaan contribute to global objectives of reducing malnutrition and improving health outcomes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Poshan Abhiyaan involves the use of **ICT-based real-time monitoring** to ensure transparency and accountability in service delivery.
 
• The initiative complements existing schemes like the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)** and **Mid-Day Meal Scheme**, amplifying their impact.
 
• Community participation through initiatives like **Poshan Melas** and **Village Health and Nutrition Days** enhances the program's outreach and effectiveness.
 
• The **Jan Andolan** aspect of Poshan Abhiyaan aims to make nutrition a people-centric movement, encouraging grassroots involvement.
